description: What stops a work item from being fed, claimed or built, whatever its position (work_item). An item that carries any of these is held; removing it lets the item go on from where it was. An assignee or an open pull request is not a hold: it is a position.
name: work_hold

terms.description: Stopped at a question only a human can answer; the question is in the comments. Set by the member who stops; a human answers and clears it.
terms.label: Needs input

terms.description: Waiting on other work. Derived from blocked-by edges when there are any; set and cleared by hand only for a block outside the tracker, such as a spec RFC not yet accepted.
terms.label: Blocked

terms.description: Serves no ranked objective in the active period. It returns when a period ranks it, or when ranked work depends on it.
terms.label: Parked
